title: Tell the caller what a solve means
heading: A Handler Turns the Reason Into What the Caller Should Do
cases: an OPTIMAL solve gives action 'use', its objective value and a gap of 0
an INFEASIBLE solve gives action 'conflict' and no value
a FEASIBLE solve gives action 'use-with-gap', its value, the distance between its bounds and the limit's name
a NO_SOLUTION_FOUND solve gives action 'retry', no value and the limit's name
an UNBOUNDED solve gives action 'model-error' and no value, even when it carries a plan
IMPRECISE, NUMERICAL_ERROR and OTHER_ERROR give action 'solver-error'
